This '''camp''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and was used by a group of researchers. Nearly nine years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] scholar [[Tionne Solusar]] set out to find [[Kalgrath]], the researchers informed her that they noted a dark shadows lurking around their camp and promised to notify her if the creature was found. Tionne described this conversation in her report.<ref name="TEGtAS" />
